exclusion_reasons.label: Not human adult population
exclusion_reasons.description: Study includes non-human subjects or pediatric population (<18 years).

exclusion_reasons.label: Not a cardiac surgical population
exclusion_reasons.description: Population does not undergo open cardiac surgery (e.g., general cardiology patients).

exclusion_reasons.label: Ineligible intervention/exposure
exclusion_reasons.description: No exposure to SGLT2 inhibitors or exposure limited to other agents only.

exclusion_reasons.label: Ineligible comparator
exclusion_reasons.description: No comparative group (e.g., placebo, standard care, or no SGLT2 inhibitor) reported.

exclusion_reasons.label: Ineligible study design
exclusion_reasons.description: Non-comparative design (e.g., single-arm study, case report, case series) or cross-sectional without comparator.

exclusion_reasons.label: Conference abstract only
exclusion_reasons.description: Conference abstract without corresponding full-text article.

exclusion_reasons.label: Not original research
exclusion_reasons.description: Review, editorial, commentary, or letter without primary data.

exclusion_reasons.label: Insufficient outcome data
exclusion_reasons.description: Does not report extractable data for prespecified outcomes.

exclusion_reasons.label: Transcatheter-only procedure
exclusion_reasons.description: Study limited to transcatheter procedures (e.g., TAVR/TAVI, PCI, MitraClip).

exclusion_reasons.label: Heart transplantation population
exclusion_reasons.description: Population limited to heart transplant recipients or procedures.

exclusion_reasons.label: Ventricular assist device population
exclusion_reasons.description: Population limited to VAD implantation or management.

exclusion_reasons.label: Duplicate
exclusion_reasons.description: Duplicate record or overlapping dataset already included.

exclusion_reasons.label: Outside perioperative window
exclusion_reasons.description: Exposure or outcomes unrelated to the preoperative or perioperative period of cardiac surgery.

exclusion_reasons.label: Full text not available
exclusion_reasons.description: Full text unavailable after reasonable effort.

search_concepts.label: Adult patients undergoing open cardiac surgery
SGLT2 inhibitors (gliflozins), preoperative or perioperative exposure

human_decisions_required.question: Should transcatheter-only cardiac procedures (e.g., TAVR/TAVI, MitraClip, PCI) be included as eligible populations?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Including transcatheter procedures broadens the population beyond open cardiac surgery and may change risk profiles and perioperative management, affecting applicability and heterogeneity.

human_decisions_required.question: Should heart transplantation procedures be included as eligible cardiac surgery?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Heart transplantation patients have unique perioperative and immunosuppressive considerations that may affect safety and efficacy outcomes.

human_decisions_required.question: Should ventricular assist device (VAD) implantation procedures be included as eligible cardiac surgery?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: VAD implantation has distinct perioperative risks and patient characteristics that may alter intervention effects and safety outcomes.

human_decisions_required.question: Should conference abstracts without full-text articles be included?
human_decisions_required.why_it_matters: Including abstracts can increase recall but may introduce incomplete data and risk of bias; exclusion may omit recent evidence.
